notes: '17HS4401' is a MotionKing model number that many Chinese makers and resellers (incl. StepperOnline, Cloudray, Usongshine, Rattm) reuse with different specs: rated current 1.5 A vs 1.7 A, torque 40–45 N·cm, body 38–40.4 mm reported across listings. Dimensions here are from the MotionKing catalog drawing (hosted by a Ukrainian distributor, svaltera.ua; motionking.com original not fetched), downloaded to motionking-hb-catalog.pdf. StepperOnline's own NEMA 17 40 mm motors use other model numbers (e.g. 17HS16-2004S1, 45 N·cm 2 A) — a human should confirm which StepperOnline SKU is intended. The Amazon pick (Cloudray B07B4QKZ5B) has a matching title but its spec table reportedly lists model 17CS04A-170 and 0.42 N·m; it is not the StepperOnline store. Amazon search alternative: https://www.amazon.com/s?k=17HS4401. Mounting standard (NEMA 17: 31 mm hole pitch, Ø22 pilot, Ø5 shaft) is consistent across sources.
